name: virtualcortex-specs
description: Documentation verification for VirtualCortex: executable architecture assertions (spec-guard) and cross-document consistency (spec-graph). The engine itself is a Rust workspace; see Cargo.toml.

scripts.spec: npm run spec:guard && npm run spec:graph && npm run spec:briefs && npm run spec:briefs:test && npm run spec:decisions && npm run spec:decisions:test && npm run spec:version && npm run spec:version:test && npm run spec:scripts:test && npm run spec:deps && npm run mutants:timeouts:test
